surfaces.name: squadra CLI and skill for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor windows

claims.answer: Terminal CLI (`squadra`) used by agents inside Claude Code, Codex and Cursor windows, plus a read-mostly local web dashboard on 127.0.0.1 (phone drawer layout); POSIX/macOS tested; no desktop app, mobile app or editor extension.

desktop_os.answer: Python scripts run on macOS and POSIX (tested); Windows process controls are not qualified; no desktop app.

browser.answer: `squadra dash --open` serves a local dashboard in a browser on 127.0.0.1 with an access token.

mobile_browser.answer: Dashboard has a phone layout but listens only on loopback, so a phone cannot reach it without the user exposing it.

editor_extensions.answer: Installed as a Claude Code/Codex plugin or skill; no editor extension.

task_actions.answer: Agents run commands to start, ack, prove, review and close; the dashboard is read-only except plugin settings; owner answers go through the coordinator.

notifications.answer: Dashboard sounds and notices when a step closes; no push notifications.

cross_device_continuity.answer: Registry is a local folder; checkpoints and save/restore-check let a user move it; no cross-device sync.

limitations: No native desktop or mobile app; dashboard is local-machine only; Windows process controls not qualified.

claims.answer: Coordinates existing Claude Code, Codex and (interactive) Cursor windows; optionally starts non-interactive Codex or Claude turns; has no model loop of its own and no model-provider choice.

harnesses.answer: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor windows are supported teammates.

model_providers.answer: Squadra does not choose models; each client uses its own.

custom_adapters.answer: Plugins add data and MCP tools, not harness adapters.

session_integration.answer: Skill-driven coordination of windows the user opened, plus `run` launching non-interactive Codex/Claude turns; Cursor interactive only.

mixed_harness_operation.answer: Builders and readers of different clients (Claude, Codex, Cursor) collaborate in one registry.

limitations: Cursor is never launched by Squadra; other CLIs are unsupported.

claims.answer: Uses whatever login each client already has; Squadra reads local session files for usage and holds no credentials; no credits.

agent_subscriptions.answer: Windows are the user's own Claude Code, Codex or Cursor sessions with their own logins.

api_accounts.answer: Possible through the clients; Squadra is agnostic.

local_models.answer: No local model support in Squadra.

provider_restrictions.answer: Provider terms on automated runs are not stated by Squadra.

limitations: No explicit subscription or key handling by Squadra.
claims.unknownReason: Provider terms on automated runs are vendor policy facts not in the repository.

claims.answer: Install by pasting a sentence into an agent (plan, confirm, install), via /plugin, or the standalone installer; then init a registry, start a Claude coordinator, join other windows.

no_git.answer: Git is a stated requirement for proof and candidate freezing.

hosted_git.answer: No hosted-Git integration; pushes are the agent's and flagged by checklist.

limitations: Requires Python 3.12+, Git and a project checkout per builder; no hosted or VPS onboarding.

evidence.locator: What Squadra does; Installation; First steps; Dashboard; Plugins; Commands; Operating boundaries
evidence.finding: Skill + CLI + local dashboard coordinating Claude Code, Codex and Cursor windows through a shared SQLite registry with tasks, acknowledgements, executed proofs, independent reads and owner decisions; free MIT; Python 3.12+; macOS/POSIX tested; 66 subcommands.

evidence.title: Setup guide
evidence.finding: Agent-guided install plan with user confirmation; plugin or standalone installer.

evidence.title: Privacy notice
evidence.locator: What is stored; The Usage page; The dashboard and external services
evidence.finding: Local registry (mode 0700/0600); no author-operated service; usage read from local Claude/Codex session files keeping token counts only; dashboard on 127.0.0.1 with access token and Host check; plugin secrets stored in plaintext files.

evidence.title: Security policy
evidence.finding: Latest release only receives fixes; private GitHub advisories.

evidence.title: Work, proof and review
evidence.locator: Assignment, proof, independent read, closure; automatic lanes; light route
evidence.finding: Task assignment with owner/reader, ACK before start, frozen proved candidate, non-author review bound to the exact fingerprint, closure by coordinator; stale proof invalidates review; lanes split independent paths.

evidence.title: Native runners
evidence.finding: run starts a non-interactive Codex or Claude turn for reading or building; Cursor is refused; exit 0 alone is not a valid result.

evidence.title: Recovery and dashboard page guide
evidence.finding: Dashboard views, phone drawer layout, checkpoints, save/restore-check, window replacement and context handover.

evidence.title: Usage reference
evidence.finding: Local token usage by window/model/task read from Claude Code and Codex session files with optional user-priced estimates; no conversation text stored.

evidence.title: Plugin contract
evidence.finding: Local data plugins under ~/.squadra/plugins with producers; bundled catalogue (memoranda, Playwright, Sentry); no downloads or automatic execution by the dashboard.

evidence.title: Squadra skill
evidence.finding: Skill instructions agents follow for coordination, proof and review.

evidence.title: Squadra CLI
evidence.finding: Python stdlib CLI with subcommands init, agent, task, ack, prove, deliver, review, check, close, run, dash, usage, balance and more.

evidence.title: Registry store
evidence.finding: SQLite registry with hash-chained transactional events and content-addressed artifacts.

evidence.title: Dashboard server
evidence.finding: Local dashboard server with per-run access token, Host header allowlist for 127.0.0.1/localhost/[::1] and 403/401 refusals.

evidence.title: Native runner implementation
evidence.finding: Implements non-interactive Codex/Claude runs with receipts and cancellation.

evidence.title: Balance advisor
evidence.finding: Read-only suggestion of which window or model takes the next task from load, quota and similar work; assigns nothing.

evidence.title: Checklist
evidence.finding: Read-only checks at resume, assignment, delivery and push.

evidence.title: Changelog
evidence.finding: Frequent releases through 3.15.1; no dated future commitments.

evidence.title: MIT License
evidence.finding: MIT License.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 1280 stars, MIT, pushed 2026-11-12, no homepage; latest release v3.15.1 (2026-11-09).

evidence.title: Dashboard Summary screenshot
evidence.finding: Summary view of the real dashboard rendered on a synthetic Atlas registry.

evidence.title: Bounded search: other clients
evidence.locator: grep over scripts/, SKILL.md, references/, tools/, agents/, plugins/ for ios, android, electron, tauri, vscode extension, mobile app
evidence.finding: No iOS/Android app, desktop app or editor extension; the dashboard is a local web page with a phone drawer layout.

evidence.title: Bounded search: pull requests and diffs
evidence.locator: grep for gh pr create, create_pull_request, pull request, unified diff, git diff, side-by-side across scripts/, references/, SKILL.md, plugins/
evidence.finding: No PR creation, merge or diff-view implementation; only a mention in plugin authoring text.

evidence.title: Bounded search: schedules and webhooks
evidence.locator: grep for crontab, cron, schedule, webhook across scripts/, references/, SKILL.md
evidence.finding: No scheduler or webhook for starting work; waits are advisory warnings and plugin docs mention schedule in other contexts.

evidence.title: Bounded search: users, roles and SSO
evidence.locator: grep for saml, oidc, sso, rbac, organization, membership across scripts/, references/
evidence.finding: No multi-user accounts, human roles or SSO; coordinator/builder/reader are agent-window roles.

evidence.title: Bounded search: hosted or container execution
evidence.locator: grep for docker, container image, vm, hosted service, saas, vendor cloud across scripts/, references/, README
evidence.finding: No container/VM isolation implementation and no hosted service; windows run on the user machine.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry
evidence.locator: grep for telemetry, analytics, posthog, sentry_dsn, beacon across scripts/, references/, plugins/
evidence.finding: No telemetry sender; usage references describe local token reading only.

evidence.title: Bounded search: MCP server
evidence.locator: grep for mcp server, serve mcp across scripts/
evidence.finding: Squadra exposes no MCP server; MCP appears in the plugin system as optional connected tools used by agents (Playwright, Sentry).

evidence.title: Bounded search: Squadra-created isolation
evidence.locator: grep for worktree add, git worktree, checkout creation across scripts/
evidence.finding: Squadra creates no checkout or window; each builder uses an already registered separate checkout.
